# Research intake record template

Copy to a scoped research task. [Intake procedure](../research-intake.md) owns the
workflow; [goals](../goals.md) owns investment constraints.

- Candidate ID and status: discovered / screened / blocked / reproduced / evaluated / adopted / rejected
- Source repository, original paper, reviewed date:
- Exact revision, relevant file paths and hashes:
- Claim/mechanism and intended benefit:
- Universe, frequency, holding period, leverage/shorting, liquidity assumptions:
- Goal fit and reason to pursue or reject:
- Code license/attribution and separate data rights:
- Input datasets, versions, availability/cost, point-in-time properties:
- Reported metrics, benchmark, dates, costs, dividends, variant count:
- Missing evidence and reproducibility blockers:
- Scoped reproduction command/environment, artifacts, expected comparison:
- Actual result and discrepancies (leave unverified until performed):
- Predeclared evaluation plan and risk/cost/stress checks:
- Adoption decision, local changes, attribution, validation evidence:
- Next action:
